 NBA NBA injury report: Embiid, Irving, Reaves listed on Sunday, November 15
 By TalkBasket.net · Nov 15, 2026 9:37 AM GMT · 5 min read Photo: NBA/YouTube Joel Embiid, Kawhi Leonard and Austin Reaves are among the players ruled out on the NBA injury report for Sunday, November 15, while Kyrie Irving and Scottie Barnes are questionable. Andrew Nembhard has been downgraded to out, Tyrese Haliburton, Fred VanVleet, Kon Knueppel and Chet Holmgren are also out, and Max Christie is doubtful.
 Updated: Sunday, November 15, 1:00 p.m. ET (6:00 p.m. GMT). This report is updated as new injury information comes in. For every team, see our permanent NBA injury report .
 Key injuries for Sunday, November 15
 Out: Joel Embiid (76ers, right foot plantar fascia injury management), Kawhi Leonard (Raptors, left knee injury management), Austin Reaves (Lakers, left heel contusion/bone bruise ), Tyrese Haliburton (Pacers, left hamstring strain ), Andrew Nembhard (Pacers, left hip soreness/tightness), Fred VanVleet (Rockets, right knee injury management), Dereck Lively II (Mavericks, right foot surgery), Kon Knueppel (Hornets, left hamstring strain ), Dennis Schroder (Hornets, left hamstring strain), Chet Holmgren (Thunder, right knee injury recovery ), Jalen Williams (Thunder, left ankle surgery ), Jaren Jackson Jr. (Jazz, right MCL tear ), Lauri Markkanen (Jazz, right hand fracture ) and Bradley Beal (Clippers, right knee injury management).
 Questionable: Kyrie Irving (Mavericks, left knee injury management), Scottie Barnes (Raptors, left groin strain), Santi Aldama (Mavericks, left ankle sprain), Collin Sexton (Lakers, right orbital laceration), Jock Landale (Hawks, right hip inflammation), Alex Sarr (Wizards, illness), Keegan Murray (Kings, illness) and Ajay Mitchell (Thunder, left ankle sprain).
 ADVERTISEMENT Doubtful: Max Christie (Mavericks, left ankle sprain) and Jalen Wilson (Hawks, two-way G League assignment).
 Probable: Daniel Gafford (Mavericks, right shoulder stinger).
 Available: T.J. McConnell (Pacers, right hamstring strain), Aaron Nesmith (Pacers, left hand sprain) and Steven Adams (Rockets, right soleus strain).

 Pacers at 76ers injury report (1 p.m. ET)
 Pacers injury report
 Indiana has downgraded Andrew Nembhard to out with left hip soreness/tightness. Tyrese Haliburton (left hamstring strain), Johnny Furphy (right ACL repair/surgery) and Ben Sheppard (left meniscus tear) are also out. T.J. McConnell (right hamstring strain) and Aaron Nesmith (left hand sprain) have been upgraded to available.
 76ers injury report
 Philadelphia will be without Joel Embiid (right foot plantar fascia injury management), Dominick Barlow (low back stress reaction), Adem Bona (cervical spine sprain) and Ariel Hukporti (right Achilles tendon rupture/tear).
 Lakers at Suns injury report (4 p.m. ET)
 Lakers injury report
 The Lakers list Austin Reaves out with a left heel contusion/bone bruise and Cameron Carr out with an illness. Bronny James (illness), Collin Sexton (right orbital laceration) and Adou Thiero (left ankle sprain) are questionable. Quentin Grimes is available and listed with a right finger splint.
 Suns injury report
 Phoenix lists Mark Williams out following left shoulder surgery.
 Hornets at Clippers injury report (4:30 p.m. ET)
 Hornets injury report
 Charlotte will be without Kon Knueppel and Dennis Schroder, both with left hamstring strains. Michael Ajayi and Kylan Boswell are out on two-way G League assignments, and Hannes Steinbach is out on a G League assignment.
 Clippers injury report
 The Clippers list Bradley Beal out for right knee injury management, Brandon Ingram out following right heel surgery, Jordan Miller out following left rotator cuff surgery and Yanic Konan Niederhauser out following right Lisfranc surgery. Nick Martinelli is questionable on a two-way G League assignment.
 Spurs at Jazz injury report (5 p.m. ET)
 Spurs injury report
 San Antonio lists Tobias Harris out with a left calf strain and Jayden Quaintance out following right knee surgery. Maliq Brown and Ja’Kobi Gillespie are out on two-way G League assignments.
 Jazz injury report
 Utah will be without Lauri Markkanen (right hand fracture), Jaren Jackson Jr. (right MCL tear), Jusuf Nurkic (right second plantar plate tear) and Jaxson Hayes (left knee strain). Trey Alexander, Kobe Bufkin and Harrison Ingram are out on two-way G League assignments.
 Mavericks at Celtics injury report (6 p.m. ET)
 Mavericks injury report
 Dallas lists Kyrie Irving as questionable for left knee injury management and Santi Aldama as questionable with a left ankle sprain. Max Christie is doubtful with a left ankle sprain, and Daniel Gafford is probable with a right shoulder stinger. Dereck Lively II (right foot surgery), Tarik Biberovic (right heel bursitis) and Sergio de Larrea (right knee sprain) are out. Caleb Martin is available and listed with a right thumb splint.
 Celtics injury report
 Boston lists Devin Carter, Dillon Mitchell and Amari Williams as questionable on two-way G League assignments. Christopher Cenac Jr. is questionable on a G League assignment.
 Knicks at Raptors injury report (6 p.m. ET)
 Knicks injury report
 New York has no players listed.
 Raptors injury report
 Toronto lists Kawhi Leonard out for left knee injury management and Nate Bittle out with a right foot avulsion fracture. Scottie Barnes is questionable with a left groin strain. Kevin McCullar Jr. and Malachi Smith are out on two-way G League assignments.
 Rockets at Wizards injury report (7 p.m. ET)
 Rockets injury report
 Houston will be without Fred VanVleet (right knee injury management) and Clint Capela (right ankle sprain). Marcus Smart is out serving a league suspension. Steven Adams has been upgraded to available with a right soleus strain. Quadir Copeland and Julian Phillips are out on two-way G League assignments.
 Wizards injury report
 Washington lists Bub Carrington (chest/sternum contusion), Tre Johnson (low back soreness) and Alex Sarr (illness) as questionable. Felix Okpara is questionable on a two-way G League assignment. Reece Beekman (right AC joint injury), Justin Champagnie (right foot surgery), Tristan Vukcevic (left hip impingement) and Jamir Watkins (left ACL repair/surgery) are out.
 Hawks at Bucks injury report (8 p.m. ET)
 Hawks injury report
 Atlanta will be without Kingston Flemings (lumbar strain), Keshon Gilbert (left knee inflammation; non-surgical procedure), Mouhamed Gueye (left foot fracture), Asa Newell (left great toe hyperextension) and Henri Veesaar ( right ACL tear ). Jock Landale has been downgraded to questionable with right hip inflammation. Jalen Wilson is doubtful on a two-way G League assignment.
 Bucks injury report
 Milwaukee lists Ryan Rollins as questionable with an illness and Ousmane Dieng out with a left finger sprain. Kam Jones, Pete Nance and Cormac Ryan are out on two-way G League assignments, and Bogoljub Markovic is out on a G League assignment.
 Thunder at Kings injury report (9 p.m. ET)
 Thunder injury report
 Oklahoma City will be without Chet Holmgren (right knee injury recovery), Thomas Sorber (right knee surgery), Cason Wallace (left shoulder surgery), Jalen Williams (left ankle surgery) and Jaylin Williams (low back spasms). Ajay Mitchell is questionable with a left ankle sprain.
 Kings injury report
 Sacramento lists Precious Achiuwa (left ankle soreness) and Keegan Murray (illness) as questionable. Maxime Raynaud is out with a right patella subluxation, and Ben Simmons is out following right Achilles tendon repair surgery. Jonathan Mogbo and Sean Pedulla are out on two-way G League assignments.
